notes.title: New Version of "Fishing Girl's Fantasy"
notes.notes: [olist][*][p]A new Staff System has been introduced, allowing you to hire staff and enjoy "hands-off management" functionality—expand your restaurant to your heart's content now![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]More vibrant guest avatars have been added; stay tuned for subsequent storylines to unfold.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Optimizations have been made to task progression pacing and numerical gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Visual art for cafeteria scenes has been enhanced.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]New background music has been added to cafeteria scenes.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: ​Russian, Korean, and Traditional Chinese​ Added
notes.notes: [p]We’re thrilled to announce that Fishing Girl's Fantasy has been updated to support [b]​Russian, Korean, and Traditional Chinese​[/b] languages, bringing the joy of angling to players around the globe in their preferred tongue.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645310/a253e003f7a5ac3f9c9b40a159c06b676e89ee26.jpg"][/img][/p]
